info.title: bConnect Assets API
info.description:
The methods offered here provide support for querying assets and asset types.
Well known GUIDs: [Asset Stock: D4E3C25B-A3AB-4204-9D26-08ECC6237DC6 ] The bConnect V2 PowerShell module is available from the PowerShell Gallery.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
Sorts results by property name and with sort direction. Multiple properties are separated by comma.
Possible values are AssetId, OwnerId, OwnerType, etc (e.g. OwnerId asc).

parameters.name: SearchQuery
parameters.description:
Filters results by matching the given value against searchable properties.
Searchable values are Name, InventoryNumber, Contact and CostCenter.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: Filters result by matching the exact value against DisplayName.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The zero-indexed number of the first page that begins the set of pages that are returned in the response.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of items to list on a single page. For example, if page_size is 10, each page shows ten items.
A valid value is a non-negative, non-zero integer. The default value is 20. Maximum value is 1000.

requestBody.description:
The asset to be created

Initialize in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCAssetsAssetForCreation`

schema.description: Asset with fields which can be set during creation with a POST request

201.description: Creates an asset according to the specified properties

403.description: Object creation rights are missing for parent object

404.description: Either invalid input or the parent of the asset does not exist or is not visible due to missing read rights

409.description: A value was tried to be set twice where duplicates are not allowed

200.description: Returns the asset with the specified id

404.description: An asset with the specified id does not exist

requestBody.description:
A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object. The example document contains all modifiable asset properties.

Initialize patch operations in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCPatchOperation`

400.description: Input data is missing or invalid

200.description: Updates an asset according to the specified properties

403.description: Object modify rights are missing for parent object

404.description: Either invalid input or the asset does not exist or is not visible due to missing read rights

204.description: Asset successfully deleted or does not exist

403.description: Delete rights are missing for asset object
